diseño: 3 arms within each behavior segment: holdout, generic campaign, segment-tailored campaign
comparacion_primaria: tailored vs generic within each segment (two primary segment comparisons)
resultado_primario: any coupon redemption within 30 days of assignment

supuestos.method: normal approximation for two independent proportions, rounded up
supuestos.lifts: relative lift above historical descriptive proxy

formula: n por brazo = (p1(1-p1) + p2(1-p2)) × (z_{1-α/2} + z_{potencia})² / (p2-p1)², aproximación normal para dos proporciones independientes, redondeo hacia arriba

capacidad_actual.reason: 30% MDE requires 6,152 households per arm in the lower-activity segment and 1,217 per arm in the higher-activity segment; there are 749/1,568 households total in the respective segments at this cut and historical assignment cannot be randomized retroactively.

limitaciones: Historical campaign response rates are nonrandomized, repeated household-campaign observations and not causal baselines.
Cutoff rates overlap; their unweighted average is a planning proxy only.
The calculation does not account for noncompliance, attrition, interference or household-level clustering beyond one-row-per-household randomization.
A genuine campaign test requires a new prospective randomized assignment; no control assignment is fabricated from Complete Journey.
La estimación de potencia no sustituye la asignación aleatoria ni la recolección de resultados.
Los hogares del cohorte actual no alcanzan para un efecto modesto; haría falta un padrón elegible nuevo.

aleatorizador.correccion: la columna randomization_confirmed ya no la escribe el aleatorizador: exige evidencia externa del manifiesto

analizador.correccion: verifica el sha256 del manifiesto de asignación y aplica corrección de Holm a las comparaciones
